hint.text: A subordinate clause always starts with a subordinating conjunction. It can be the first or second clause in the sentence.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the most suitable subordinating conjunction.

atoms.b: I will go to the park ((++even_if so_that)) it rains.
We play football together ((++because after)) we like sports.
((++While Until)) he was on his bike, Archie hurt his knee.
Lola was upset ((++that still)) her sister was mean to her.
((++Although When)) she is ill, my grandmother came to visit.
My teacher was impressed with my work ((++as when)) it was better than my friend’s.
I cannot have dinner ((++until whenever)) my parents get home.
((++As_long_as Just_as)) he cleans his room, my brother can go to the party.
